list.heading: Members
list.description: Everyone signs in with their own Clerk account. What they may do is decided by their roles alone.
list.noActiveRole: No effective role – sees no section

addDialog.title: Add member
addDialog.description: Pick a Clerk account that is not linked yet. Invite new people in the Clerk dashboard first.
addDialog.noEmail: No primary email – add one in Clerk first
addDialog.emptyDescription: Every Clerk account is already linked. Invite the person in the Clerk dashboard, then open this dialog again.
addDialog.noMatches: No free account matches your search.
addDialog.rolesHint: At least one role. You grant the owner role after adding the member.

rolesDialog.title: Roles of {name}
rolesDialog.description: The change applies from this person's next request.
rolesDialog.ownerNote: The owner role stays. You change it with “Remove owner role”.
rolesDialog.previewEmpty: Without a role the person can sign in but sees no section.
rolesDialog.conflict: Someone just changed these roles. Your selection is kept – compare it with the current state before saving again.

ownerDialog.grantDescription: Owners have every permission, including members, roles, export and permanent deletion.
ownerDialog.revokeDescription: The person keeps their other roles and loses owner permissions from their next request.
ownerDialog.conflict: Someone just changed this member. The current state is loaded – confirm again if you still want this.
ownerDialog.alreadyGranted: {name} is already an owner. Nothing left to do.
ownerDialog.alreadyRevoked: {name} is no longer an owner. Nothing left to do.

errors.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: This member no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some details are missing. Check account and roles.
errors.CLERK_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: Clerk no longer knows this account. Open the dialog again.
errors.CLERK_ACCOUNT_INCOMPLETE: This account has no primary email. Add one in the Clerk dashboard.
errors.CLERK_ACCOUNT_ALREADY_LINKED: This account is already linked to a member.
errors.CLERK_UNAVAILABLE: Clerk is not reachable right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.ROLE_NOT_ASSIGNABLE: At least one role is inactive or no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.OWNER_ROLE_NOT_ASSIGNABLE: Grant the owner role with “Make owner”.
errors.MEMBER_WITHOUT_ROLE: Every member needs at least one role. Assign another role first.
errors.ALREADY_OWNER: This person is already an owner.
errors.NOT_OWNER: This person is no longer an owner.
errors.LAST_ACTIVE_OWNER: The workspace needs at least one active owner. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.SELF_OWNER_REVOCATION: You cannot remove your own owner role. Only another owner can do that.
errors.MEMBER_ALREADY_ACTIVE: This member is already active. Reload the page.
errors.MEMBER_ALREADY_INACTIVE: This member is already deactivated. Reload the page.
errors.SELF_DEACTIVATION: You cannot deactivate your own access. Only another owner can do that.
errors.MEMBER_HAS_OPEN_RESPONSIBILITIES: This member still has open customer responsibilities and therefore cannot be deactivated.
errors.INTERNAL: That did not work. Try again.
